def bboxes():
    a = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    out = {}
    for name, ch, r0, r1, c0, c1 in [('n4','B',15,40,0,33), ('n7','B',15,40,33,63)]:

        if cells: out[name] = (min(r for r,c in cells), max(r for r,c in cells), min(c for r,c in cells), max(c for r,c in cells))
    return out
print("before:", bboxes())
action(['LEFT'])

</parameter>
